title: "Astronauts Track Missile in Space In 'Typical Day' Aboard Gemini 5" – Washington Post
description: Newspaper clipping by Howard Simons, Washington Post Staff Writer, datelined Houston, Aug. 24, reporting that the Gemini 5 crew spotted, tracked and photographed a Minuteman ICBM launched from California. Subheads include "'Dull' and 'Typical'", "Trouble in Spotting" and "Questions Raised", the last discussing Defense Department experiments on a NASA flight. The article ends with a reference to a chronology on Page A10.
